book_title: A Chance to Die: The Life and Legacy of Amy Carmichael
author: Elisabeth Elliot
book_description: A Chance to Die is a biography of Amy Carmichael, an Irish missionary and writer who spent fifty-three years in south India without furlough. There she became known as ''Amma,'' or ''mother,'' as she founded the Dohnavur Fellowship, a refuge for underprivileged children.
